fixes.A15-F01: Shared SwiftUI period buttons with explicit selected state and keyboard dismissal; same full search/clear/search/clear/period/detail journey passed, with return preserving period.
fixes.A15-F02: Analytics empty cards use unrestricted description wrapping; nontechnical localized period-empty copy in a named uk/de catalog.
fixes.A15-F03: Current account card no longer nests a full metric tile; shorter heading, side-by-side icon/value, compact overview tiles, one comparison caption for the group.
fixes.A15-F04: Separate current account vs period semantics; actual cache data time preserved; explicit incomplete-Today versus complete-yesterday comparison, Vienna and UTC boundaries and correct hourly/five-minute cadence.
fixes.A15-F05: Bounded 48-entry, 60-second memory cache shared across destinations; identical reads coalesce; manual refresh invalidates; midnight invalidates correct clock; principal/role/session generation fences and direct current-access readback; no private disk cache. Removed duplicate initial .task plus lifecycle load from root/details.
fixes.A15-F06: Checked counter decoder rejects booleans, fractions, NaN/infinity, negatives, unrepresentable JS integers and aggregate overflow. Invalid present data fails its source instead of authoritative zero; absent legacy optional counters remain zero.
fixes.A15-F07: Explains loaded-report search and top20 per type for 7/30 days; no claim that ranking sums equal all activity. The new localized current-account heading is included in section search terms; both languages and the full linked journey are tested.
fixes.A15-F08: Persistent tap-to-select chart day, metric selection and fewer x-axis labels to avoid collisions.
